accepted_claims: For every nonempty simply connected planar domain Omega and every p,q in Omega, c_0 d_Omega(p,q) <= rho_Omega(p,q) <= d_Omega(p,q).
c_0 = exp(-8 exp(9/2)/(3 sqrt(2 pi)))/2 is positive, exact, universal and unchanged from the credited source.
The whole plane, equal points, arbitrary boundary irregularity, unbounded domains and infinite inner diameter are included.
The bounded Theorem 1.1 consequence is the existence of an unbounded holomorphic function with bounded derivative exactly for simply connected domains of infinite inner diameter.
assumptions: Omega is a nonempty connected open simply connected subset of the complex plane.
p and q are arbitrary points of Omega, including p=q.
Admissible functions are holomorphic with derivative modulus at most one everywhere; the function need not be bounded.
corrections: Integral remainder or interval supremum, not just the second derivative at one point
